note: TCRN-CROSS-STORY-474 AC1, AC4 (TCRN-CROSS-SUB-303): everyday prompts that have nothing to do with the library, eight in English and eight in Chinese, written before any score was read. Every one must be answered with nothing at the strong-hit threshold, and at least one must be answered with the threshold at zero. The English ones carry the pronoun I, the article a and the preposition in on purpose (TCRN-CROSS-SUB-302's finding): a one-letter word used to reach the external-key column as a prefix.
